fields.description: The box this card is in. A GPU belongs to a Machine, not to the Inference Server that happens to serve from it.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: Resolved from whatever the scan reported. A MIG slice resolves to its own type, not its parent's.
fields.label: GPU Type

fields.description: Exactly what CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is given: GPU- for a whole card, MIG- for a slice, or the bare CUDA index on a cloud box seeded before any driver existed. Stable, which the index is not.
fields.label: Device ID

fields.description: Ordering and display only. nvidia-smi order moves on a reseat, and a MIG slice has none at all, so nothing addresses a card by this.
fields.label: CUDA Index

fields.description: What the card can do, off its type. bfloat16 needs 8.0 and an fp8 KV cache needs 8.9, so a placement checks this before a play starts rather than letting vLLM raise on the box.
fields.label: Compute Capability

fields.description: The replica holding this card, or blank. Taken by a compare-and-swap, so two replicas cannot both win it. Being a column on the card rather than a row of its own is what stops a claim outliving the card it names.
fields.label: Held By
